The card's entry_symbols list is empty and the pinned clone has no Python device class for the ROS node, so this is a configuration-only ROS 1 RosDriver with no native.py and no invented Python native. SELECTED DEVICE: the simulated TurtleBot RGB camera stream. The node creates the Image publisher on /gibson_ros/camera/rgb/image with queue size 10 (igibson-ros/turtlebot_rgbd.py:35), imports sensor_msgs.msg Image (turtlebot_rgbd.py:16), converts obs['rgb'] with cv2_to_imgmsg encoding rgb8 (turtlebot_rgbd.py:85-90), stamps the header with rospy.Time.now and sets frame_id camera_depth_optical_frame (turtlebot_rgbd.py:94-100), and the configuration selects a 256x256 image with 90 degree vertical FOV (igibson-ros/turtlebot_rgbd.yaml:61-63). The package exposes cap.sensing.image.v1 with the fixed selector camera=color and captures one complete sensor_msgs/Image packet per call into a bounded local PNG artifact through the implemented ROS image path; the artifact descriptor retains the observed ROS 1 header (seq, stamp, frame_id). The image budgets max_input_bytes 1048576 and max_pixels 1048576 are client conversion bounds, not device limits, and admit the configured 256x256 rgb8 frame (196608 bytes). No numeric device Limit is declared, so site-limits.example.json is not needed.

SCOPE AND NOT COVERED: only the RGB color image is served. The upstream depth Image (float32 passthrough at turtlebot_rgbd.py:86-92), /gibson_ros/camera/depth/image_raw, /gibson_ros/lidar/points PointCloud2, /odom, /ground_truth_odom, /gibson_ros/camera/depth/camera_info and TF are NOT COVERED. The /mobile_base/commands/velocity Twist motion input and the /reset_pose PoseStamped teleport input (turtlebot_rgbd.py:43-44) are also NOT COVERED: the clone declares no acknowledged ROS stop service or action, the main loop steps iGibsonEnv with [cmdx, cmdy] (turtlebot_rgbd.py:77-79), and a zero-velocity topic publication or node shutdown is not an acknowledged stop (MHS/sdk/docs/ros-driver.md). Because the chosen device is the passive camera, this package makes no motion, teleport, simulator-stepping or physical-stop claim; the software e-stop latches and refuses new captures only.

FAKE FIDELITY: F0 analytic ROS-free RecordingRosTransport handler. It answers the one declared subscribe with a canned 2x2 rgb8 placeholder packet and runs no iGibson environment, renderer, physics step, 30 Hz loop, sensor noise, message drops or fragmentation; it does not replay captured traffic. The configured real image is 256x256 with frame camera_depth_optical_frame; the fake's dimensions, pixels, seq, stamp, frame id and negative-path switches are placeholders. The fake models malformed step, unsupported encoding, missing ROS 1 seq and a silent topic as negative cases.
